newsitem.title: USA: All American Semi sees profit in Q1 1997.
newsitem.headline: All American Semi sees profit in Q1 1997.

text.p: All American Semiconductor, a distributor of semicondustors and electronic components, said Monday it expects to show a small profit in the first quarter of 1997, despite its prediction that first quarter 1997 sales will be below sales in the first quarter of 1996.
One year ago, the firm reported first quarter net income of one cent per share on sales of 67.1 million.

The company said it believes that the fundamentals of its industry have been improving and that All American has seen a growth in bookings and backlog during the first quarter of 1997 compared with the second half of 1996.

The company said that as a result of prior expansion, it still has excess plant capacity which will enable it to improve productivity and efficiencies in future periods, provided it attain its sales growth goals.
